content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture of crypto payment gateways for digital products is designed to empower creators by eliminating the reliance on conventional payment platforms. This matters because it allows for greater control, lower fees, and immediate access to funds. For instance, while Gumroad charges a hefty 10% fee per sale, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This dramatic difference not only enhances profitability but also enables creators to retain more revenue, allowing them to scale their businesses more effectively.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the infrastructure relies on a combination of free and open-source tools to create a seamless transaction experience. For hosting, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are utilized, while backend logic is handled through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order details can be stored using Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Crypto payment processing is handled automatically by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions on-chain. This setup ensures that creators retain full ownership and control over their sales without any ongoing subscription fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways have failed. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this solution is tailor-made for those who want to operate independently. It empowers you to run a fully operational online store without the constraints imposed by platforms that charge high fees or require extensive verification. The goal is to give you the tools you need to succeed without sacrificing ownership or incurring unnecessary costs.
Say goodbye to high platform fees and hello to more profit.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture comprises several key components that work in unison to deliver a complete solution. First, hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provides a stable and free platform for your store. Then, backend processes managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script ensure that all transactions are executed smoothly. Supabase or Google Sheets store your order data securely, while file delivery happens through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments handles the crypto payment processing with low fees, ensuring that you keep most of your earnings. Each piece is integral to creating an efficient and autonomous digital commerce infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select the appropriate stack for your needs, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Follow the deployment documentation provided to set up your hosting and backend processes. Load your products into your chosen storage solution and configure NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions. Test your setup thoroughly to ensure everything works as intended. Lastly, launch your store and promote your digital products with confidence, knowing you have a robust infrastructure behind you. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a crypto payment gateway. This setup allows you to accept payments directly in cryptocurrency, bypassing the need for traditional payment processors entirely. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments, you can efficiently handle transactions, ensuring lower fees and faster access to your funds.

Store your order details using Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Test your entire setup before launching your store. Promote your digital products confidently once everything is functional.
